description.value: Seaside Hotel is a boutique waterfront property on the North Vancouver shoreline, operated under the Executive Hotels & Resorts group, with panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and Vancouver skyline from signature rooms featuring natural Pacific Northwest-inspired design. The hotel includes an on-site Italian restaurant (Provisions Italiana) and a third-floor spa with floor-to-ceiling ocean views. Located steps from the Lonsdale Quay SeaBus terminal, it offers straightforward transit access to both North Shore outdoor recreation and downtown Vancouver.

address.value: 130-125 Victory Ship Way, North Vancouver, BC V7L 0G5

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 97m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The hotel website is fully accessible and confirms the property is open and actively promoting 2026 FIFA World Cup stays. OSM contact details (phone 604-973-1473, address 130-125 Victory Ship Way) match the website exactly. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or most other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content; however, on-site restaurant Provisions Italiana is explicitly described, confirming nearby evening food.
concerns: Hotel policy states all registered guests must be 21 years of age or older, which is atypical and may affect some touring cyclists.

Room amenities list on /rooms/ was truncated mid-sentence ('50" HD Smart TVs / Work'), so some amenities such as Wi-Fi could not be confirmed from website text despite OSM tagging internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating boutique hotel on the North Vancouver waterfront with a fully active website, confirmed contact details, and no indicators of closure.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site restaurant Provisions Italiana serves Italian cuisine; described as 'some of the most delectable cuisine on the west coast' in a lounge setting
